newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro plans 20-year debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro plans 20-year debenture issue.

text.p: Norwegian industrial giant Norsk Hydro ASA said on Monday it planned a new issue of 20-year debentures to the aggregate amount of $250 million under its current shelf registration in the U.S. market.
A spokesman for the company said the issue was partly to restructure Norsk Hydro's loan portfolio and partly to take advantage of new investment opportunities.
The debentures will mature in 2016 with interest payable biannually.
The group's outstanding debt is currently rated A2 from Moody's Investors Service and A from Standard & Poor's.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc. and Goldman, Sachs & Co will act as co-managers in underwriting the issue.
Norsk Hydro's last debenture issue in 1995 was for a similar amount but for 30 years.
